Schur complement identity for the resolvent of a two-block self-adjoint matrix (soft sector, stiff sector): inverse energy of a defect equals the stiff-block inverse energy plus a Schur-complement correction, and the off-diagonal coupling keeps that correction from vanishing even when the defect has zero soft component
